lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf2Tl8Ni2 (reduced formula HfTl4Ni) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 38), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Hf and Ni center has 12 Tl neighbors, while each Tl center has 12 neighbors (4 Hf, 4 Ni, 4 Tl), with neighbor distances ranging from 3.0258 to 3.2517 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show Tl–Tl 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Hf–Tl pairs sharing corners and edges.
